token_softmax_bloom.closed_selected_gap: Independent destination dtype is now represented and proved for all nine fp16/bf16/fp32 input/output pairs, including six mixed pairs. The complete row executes its original load-to-fp32, maximum/subtraction/exp/sum/division graph, then casts to the independently selected destination dtype and preserves the off-write frame.
token_softmax_bloom.source_relation: Public erased-surface equality with the complete existing token_softmax_surface; original JIT ASTs independently extracted and byte-pinned.
premises: arbitrary initial total typed-cell state, algebra and natural program ids/metadata/strides; no execution-result premise

remaining_structural_obligations.finding: The wrapper computes next_power_of_2(max_input_len), chooses num_warps at 2048/4096, and launches the full (batch,head) grid. The new result proves a single selected pid pair; cross-program composition over metadata intervals and host-selected launch is still required.

Independent source/destination storage is represented for the nine fp16/bf16/fp32 pairs only. The original caller-supplied tensors are not restricted to these pairs. Other floating formats, integer/bool storage and admission/error branches are not established by this package; no whole dtype-domain closure is claimed.

modeling_boundaries: The generalized contract uses the inherited total typed-cell state, natural metadata and natural offsets. The existing real-valued IO contract is preserved, but transporting this new mixed typed result through original finite-width metadata/address behavior and the valid physical placements/layouts of both independently typed tensors remains to connect.

The public result includes full erased-surface equality with each historical translated kernel. Exact original JIT extraction and 18 raw frontend SSA paths are retained as source evidence; these observations are not a formal Python/frontend/backend refinement or native reduction-schedule proof. Scalar conformance may be deferred only after binding the selected source graph and configuration.
token_softmax_bloom.valid_domain_note: Inherited natural metadata and strides are a legitimate selected domain. This review does not require unsupported negative indices or invent a generic hardware blocker.
